best_hour, best_val = None, None
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row["timeseries_id"] != tid: continue
        ts = row["timestamp"]
        if ts[:10] != day: continue
        v = float(row["value"])
        h = int(ts[11:13])
        if best_val is None or v > best_val or (v == best_val and h < best_hour):
            best_val = v; best_hour = h
print(best_hour, best_val)
